author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹೂವಿಂದ ರೋಲಂಬ ಶುದ್ಧಮಧು ಸೆಳೆವಂತೆ
ಸೋವಿರದ ತಜ್ಞತೆಯ ಗುರುವಿಂದ ಪಡೆವೆ
ಪಾವನವೆ ನಿನಬದುಕು ನಡೆನುಡಿಯು ಶುದ್ಧವಿರೆ
ಜೀವನದ ಗುರಿಯದುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As the bee draws pure honey from the flower,
you gain unfailing expertise from the guru;
your life is holy when your words and deeds are pure;
that is life’s goal, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We draw real skill from a teacher as the bee draws nectar. Clean speech and conduct make life sacred; that is the goal.
